speech.heard: In Finland, every man has a bank account. In Niger, only 17.6% do. Finland is the world's highest, while Niger is the world's lowest. Finland has 5.7 times the share of men with accounts that Niger has. This counts men who report having an account at a bank or using mobile money. Major economies vary. The USA has 96.9%, India 88.8%, and China 89.6%. Indonesia has 54.6%, while Pakistan has 42.3%. How many men in your country have a bank account?
